docsFolder.description: The docs folder, relative to the repo root.

vaultFolder.description: The linked folder, relative to the vault root.

deepLink.description: Opens the project's folder note through the Advanced URI plugin. Written by Project Docs while advancedUriDeepLinks is on.

privateSubfolder.description: The vault subfolder whose notes never sync to the repo.

folderNotePattern.description: Where the link note goes in the vault: the project folder's folder note.

syncAttachments.description: Also sync files other than Markdown, such as images.

keepLinksAsWritten.description: Leave Obsidian wikilinks as written instead of converting them to Markdown links.

allowLinksOutsideProjectFolder.description: Let synced notes link to vault notes outside the project folder.

advancedUriDeepLinks.description: Open the project in Obsidian through the Advanced URI plugin. Project Docs puts `uid: <project id>` in the project folder's folder note, which anchors the link to the folder however its contents change; if you add the uid by hand, put it there too.
